title: XZ Utils supply-chain compromise
description: Malicious code was introduced into the upstream xz/liblzma 5.6.0 and 5.6.1 release tarballs and could interfere with sshd authentication in affected Linux environments.

title: Looney Tunables glibc local privilege escalation
description: A buffer overflow in the GNU C Library dynamic loader's GLIBC_TUNABLES handling can allow local privilege escalation under affected configurations.

title: Out-of-bounds Write
description: The product writes data past the end of the intended buffer, which can corrupt memory and may enable code execution.

title: SQL Injection
description: Improper neutralization of special elements used in an SQL command can let attackers alter query logic.

title: Credential storage
description: Verify that passwords are stored using an approved adaptive one-way function with an appropriate work factor.

title: Overflow Buffers
description: Adversaries target buffers to overwrite memory and redirect execution flow toward attacker-controlled code.

title: Exploit Public-Facing Application
description: Adversaries may exploit weaknesses in internet-facing software to gain initial access.

title: Valid Accounts
description: Adversaries may obtain and abuse valid credentials to bypass access controls.
